_README: The declarative module library for the Acme Bank credit memo. The orchestrator derives a deal-context flag set (see conditionality.md), evaluates each module's renderWhen against it, and emits an ordered render plan. This replaces the legacy fixed 13-section memo: ONE manifest expands or contracts to cover the 80+ legacy templates. Components inherit their parent's gating, then apply their own renderWhen.
_CHANGELOG_2026-08-21: Genericized-template restructure (14 approved items, credit-memo-reinvented PR): renamed Request Details/Borrower Description/Management & Ownership/Industry Analysis/Leading Indicators/Forward Looking Recommendation for the industry-standard template; retired the Trend Reporting module and redistributed its components (risk_rating_trends -> new Risk Rating (internal) module; covenant_compliance_trends -> new Covenant and Conditions module; spreading_trends/revolver_usage_trend/current_balance_trend -> Financial Analysis; payment_history dropped as not relevant); retired Financial Model/Sensitivity and Global Cash Flow as standalone modules and folded them into Financial Analysis as the Future Outlook (nested Sensitivity Analysis) and Cash Flow Analysis sub-sections; added three new modules (Risk Rating (internal), Risk and Mitigants, Appendix); moved Conditions & Monitoring out of the Recommendation module into the new Covenant and Conditions module; added a peer_comparison component to Industry & Peer Analysis (previously an enhanced-tier-only, low-priority component of the retired Trend Reporting module).
predicateGrammar: renderWhen is one of: "always"; a flag name (true); "!flag"; "flag==value"; "flag!=value"; "flagArray includes 'x'"; an array of clauses combined with AND; or {"any":[...]} for OR. credit_event and tier are matched with ==.
ncinoSections: Each module optionally declares an ncinoSection — the nCino credit-memo section bucket it writes to on narrative sync (ncino_sync_memo_sections). The renderer groups ON modules into these 7 buckets and emits a Salesforce-RTE-safe HTML fragment per bucket (semantic tags only: p/strong/em/ul/ol/li/a/table; no class/style/SVG). The Experience MCP owns the bucket-id -> cm_* field-API-name map (executive_summary->cm_Deal_Summary_Loan__c, product_request_overview->cm_Relationship_Product_Request_Overview__c, background->cm_Background_Loan__c, financial_analysis->cm_Financial_Analysis_Loan__c, covenant_analysis->cm_Covenant_Analysis__c, collateral_analysis->cm_Collateral_Analysis_Collateral_Mgmt__c, risk_assessment->cm_Risk_Analysis_Loan__c). Modules with no ncinoSection (chrome) are omitted from the sync.
